verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office platform, and any such product could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The direct probe for llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no agent-oriented documentation appears anywhere in the evidence. Mentions of 'Registered Agent' refer to a legal compliance service, not AI agents, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
